GenerateMonsters.note: C# draws exactly one NextBool to decide the order of a LeafSlimeS/TwigSlimeS pair, and returns [TwigSlimeM, LeafSlimeM, small0, small1] -- the two mediums are fixed at positions 0-1, only the last two swap. The sim's parity branch draws selection_rng.next_bool() once and orders (LeafSlimeS,TwigSlimeS) vs (TwigSlimeS,LeafSlimeS) accordingly, returning the identical 4-element order. Executed witness (py audit/tools/encounter_probes_e2.py parity-draw-counts, seed 12345): roster=['TwigSlimeM','LeafSlimeM','LeafSlimeS','TwigSlimeS'], draws=1 -- roster (all 4 slime variants, always), order, and draw count (1) all match. See the guards entry below for the non-parity (legacy) path.

guards.what: Encounter Rng independence outside parity (default/legacy) mode
guards.rationale:
CLOSED 2026-08-03 (gap-fix pass). `RunState.create_combat` now builds the per-encounter Rng on BOTH paths: with a string seed from `rng_set.seed` as before, and without one from a run seed derived at construction (`run.derive_encounter_seed`, a hash of the shared generator's STATE, so it consumes no draw and shifts no other legacy stream). `create_monsters`' `selection_rng=None` arm is therefore unreachable from any production call site, and the composition no longer moves when the shared stream does — executed in test/test_encounter_selection_rng.py (test_the_composition_does_not_move_with_the_shared_stream) and by audit/tools/encounter_probes_e2.py legacy-shared-stream.

WHAT THE GAP SAID: Same mechanism as ruby_raiders' guard (full rationale there). With no string seed, SlimesNormalEncounter.create_monsters falls back to `rng.sample([LeafSlimeS, TwigSlimeS], 2)` on the same shared random.Random combat_rng.legacy() hands out for every other combat stream. Executed witness: py audit/tools/encounter_probes_e2.py legacy-shared-stream confirms combat._rng is combat_rng.monster_ai is combat_rng.shuffle for CombatState(encounter=SLIMES_NORMAL). Does not explain the 89U conformance divergence (89U is string-seeded and takes the correct parity branch, verdicted faithful above).
